issues.explanation: Here 屋 is used as a standalone noun meaning a house or building; labeling it a bound form is misleading in this context.
南华老仙 is a single personal epithet/name in this passage and should be kept together for tapping.
issues.suggested_fix: 南华老仙 — Nánhuá Lǎoxiān — Nanhua the Immortal

issues.explanation: In 封谞等下狱, 等 is the particle meaning “and others,” not an ordinary lexical word.
地公 is the Earth-related title element in 地公将军; glossing it as “Earth General” duplicates and obscures the following 将军.
人公 is the Human-related title element in 人公将军; “Human General” improperly includes the meaning of the following 将军.
